Partner on Arctic trade corridors — open GIS OSINT, machine-payable APIs

ArcticTradeLanes.com publishes a live Arctic atlas and machine-payable corridor intelligence for the Northern Sea Route and the Polar Silk Road. The layers are built from public records, published as GeoJSON on an EPSG:3996 polar projection, and reachable by both humans and agents.

Korea–Japan–China · Polar Silk Road

Busan · Yokohama · Ningbo · Tianjin

What partners get

Shared corridor research on RU, CA–AK and KR–JP–CN lanes, co-authored dataset expansion, and white-label or enterprise access to the route API. We work from open sources only — no classified material, no scraped credentials.
